color="#EF4444"># Check if answer is correct</font><br> <font color="#10B981">if</font> extractNumber(response) == correctAnswer:<br> reward = <font color="#10B981">+1.0</font><br> <br> <font color="#EF4444"># Bonus for clean format</font><br> <font color="#10B981">if</font> response == str(correctAnswer):<br> reward += <font color="#3B82F6">0.0</font> <font color="#64748B"># Already perfect</font><br> <font color="#F59E0B">else</font>:<br> reward -= <font color="#F59E0B">0.2</font> <font color="#64748B"># Not clean</font><br> <br> <font color="#EF4444"># Bonus for showing reasoning</font><br> <font color="#10B981">if</font> hasReasoningSteps(response):<br> reward += <font color="#3B82F6">0.2</font><br> <font color="#F59E0B">else</font>:<br> reward = <font Generate</b></font><br><font color="#94A3B8">Multiple responses</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#312E81;strokeColor=#6366F1;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="650" y="745" width="120" height="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="arrow1" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeWidth=3;strokeColor=#94A3B8;" parent="1" edge="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="780" y="772" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="820" y="772" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step2" value="<font color="#10B981"><b>2. Score</b></font><br><font color="#94A3B8">Each response</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#065F46;strokeColor=#10B981;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="830" y="745" width="120" height="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="arrow2" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeWidth=3;strokeColor=#94A3B8;" parent="1" edge="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="960" y="772" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="1000" y="772" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step3" value="<font color="#F59E0B"><b>3. Repeat!</b></font><br><font color="#94A3B8">1000s of times</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#155E75;strokeColor=#22D3EE;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="1190" y="745" width="100" height="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="domains-bg" value="" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1E293B;strokeColor=#8B5CF6;strokeWidth=3;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="990" y="530" width="320" height="150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="domains-title" value="<font color="#8B5CF6"><b>Where RLVR Shines</b></font>" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=14;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="1050" y="545" width="200" height="25" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="domains-list" value="<font color="#94A3B8"><b>Math</b> - Check if computation is correct<br><b>Coding</b> - Run tests, check output<br><b>Logic puzzles</b> - Verify solution<br><b>Games</b> - Win/lose is verifiable<br><b>Science</b> - Physical simulations</font>" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=12;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="1010" y="575" width="280" height="95" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
